text:
iza: Quick announcement — we are opening a small Dedicated GPU pool in glasgow (eu-west-3) with H200v2 hardware tomorrow 2026-05-14 09:00 UTC. Initial capacity is 12 nodes (48 vGPUs). This pool is intended for Dedicated customers only, with reserved burst for enterprise tiers. docs/runbooks/glsg-pool will have details.
simon: Nice! Any special rollout plan or can we flip it to prod immediately?
iza: Canary for first 24h: 10% traffic routing, then 50% for 12h, then full if metrics stable. Auto-fallback to eu-west-1 if capacity or SLOs drop.
anya: How do customers opt-in / book capacity? Will CSMs need to create orders?
iza: CSMs will use the Dedicated console -> Capacity -> Request additional pool and select region=glasgow. Internal orders will auto-tag with `dedicated:glasgow-h200v2`. Sales & CSMs get a reminder email at 08:00 UTC.
eric: Any billing differences compared to other H200 pools?
iza: Pricing is same as other H200v2 dedicated pools. We added a small promotional credit for early adopters: first-month 5% off for bookings made before 2026-06-14. Finance + Billing already notified.
ops-bot: [capacity-provisioner] 1765432330 - Provisioning started: 12 nodes (H200v2) in eu-west-3.
deploy-bot: [infra] 1765432400 - Network and KMS policies applied for `dedicated-glasgow` (vault path: secret/redwood/dedicated/glasgow).
simon: Any known differences in kernel/runtime for H200v2 we should call out?
iza: Runtime change: updated kernel selector to enable tensor-core tiling for H200v2. We bumped default batch-size heuristic by +10% for low-latency workloads. QA did regression tests against our baseline evals; no quality regressions found. See: https://internal.redwood.ai/eng-runtime/h200v2-notes (internal).
anya: Runbook link? Oncall rota to monitor?
iza: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/glasgow-dedicated-pool. Oncall: eng-sre week of 2026-05-12 -> primary: simon, secondary: anya. Please watch TokenLatency and TailLatency dashboards for first 48h.
eric: Do we need to update routing policies for customers who pin models?
iza: Customers who pin model versions will still route to compatible variants in the pool. If a model requires a different quantization/kernel it may fall back to eu-west-1. Add `region_preference=glasgow` tag in rollout configs to prefer the new pool.
simon: I'll schedule a quick post-launch monitoring check-in at +3h.
iza: Thanks everyone — ping me if you spot anything odd. :party_parrot:
